summary.text: Katie Fry Hester is the Democratic state senator for Maryland District 9, in office since January 2019, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Republican Ben Hightower. A nonprofit executive, she lives in Ellicott City.

paragraphs.text: Hester earned a degree in agricultural and biological engineering from Cornell University, and her career experience includes working as Americas director with The Partnering Initiative.
She succeeded Gail Bates in the Senate in January 2019.
In the 2025-2026 term she is Senate chair of the Fair Practices and State Personnel Oversight Committee and serves on the Education, Health & Environmental Affairs Committee.
She advanced from the June 23, 2026 Democratic primary unopposed.
